full_text_en:
Tiantong Securities Co., Ltd. v. Health Yuan Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. and Tiantong Securities Shenzhen Business Department — dispute over jurisdiction over a securities contract

【Ruling Summary】

Although a branch of a enterprise legal person does not have the status of a legal person, if the branch is established in accordance with the law, holds a business license, has a certain amount of operating funds, and has the capacity to conduct transactions within the approved scope of business, it falls under the category of "other organizations" as stipulated in the Civil Procedure Law and may serve as a party in civil litigation.

Supreme People's Court
Civil Ruling

(2005) Min Er Zhong Zi No. 160

Appellant (original defendant): Tiantong Securities Co., Ltd., domiciled at: 5th Floor, No. 180 Quancheng Road, Jinan City, Shandong Province.

Legal representative: Duan Hu, Chairman of the Company.

Respondent (original plaintiff): Health Yuan Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at: 23rd Floor, Diwang Commercial Center, Xinxing Plaza, No. 5002 Shennan East Road, Luohu District, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province.

Legal representative: Zhu Baoguo, Chairman of the Company.

Original defendant: Tiantong Securities Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Jixiang Middle Road Securities Business Department, domiciled at: Clubhouse, Building A, New Asia Garden, Jixiang Middle Road, Longgang District, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province.

Person in charge: Zang Xiangfeng, General Manager of the Business Department.

The appellant, Tiantong Securities Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tiantong Securities), appealed against the civil ruling (2005) Yue Gao Fa Min Er Chu Zi No. 10 rendered by the Guangdong High People's Court in a dispute over other securities contracts with the respondent, Health Yuan Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Health Yuan Company), and the original defendant, Tiantong Securities Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Jixiang Middle Road Securities Business Department (hereinafter referred to as Tiantong Securities Shenzhen Business Department), on the grounds that: the Tiantong Securities Shenzhen Business Department is a non-legal person unit, lacks the capacity to independently bear civil liability, and is not qualified to engage in entrusted asset management business, and thus should not be a defendant in this case. In this case, the appellant Tiantong Securities is the legally proper defendant. Therefore, the Guangdong High People's Court has no jurisdiction over this case, and the appellant requests the Supreme People's Court to order that the case be transferred to the Shandong High People's Court, the place where the proper defendant Tiantong Securities is domiciled.

The respondent, Health Yuan Company, did not submit a defense.

This Court holds that: Tiantong Securities Shenzhen Business Department is a branch of Tiantong Securities. Although it is not a legal person, it was established in accordance with the law, holds a business license, possesses a certain amount of operating funds, and has the capacity to conduct securities transactions and other business within its approved scope of operations. It falls under the category of "other organizations" as stipulated in the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and may serve as a party in civil litigation. As a party to the contract in dispute in this case, Tiantong Securities Shenzhen Business Department is the defendant that the plaintiff in this case sues for direct civil liability. Moreover, its registered business address is Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province. The Guangdong High People's Court has jurisdiction over this case in accordance with the law. The facts found in the original ruling are clear, and the application of the law is not erroneous. The appellant's grounds for appeal lack legal basis and are not supported by this Court. In conclusion, pursuant to Article 22, paragraphs 2 and 3, Article 49, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Item (5) of Article 40 of this Court's Opinions on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, this Court rules as follows:

The appeal is dismissed and the original ruling is affirmed.

This ruling is final.

Presiding Judge: Wu Qingbao
Acting Judge: Gong Bangyou
Acting Judge: Liu Min

August 25, 2005

Clerk: Zhao Suijun

【Introduction to the Presiding Judge】

Wu Qingbao, Senior Judge: born in 1964, Bachelor of Laws. Served as a Judge of the Supreme People's Court from 2001.
